add.title: Every Day I Live in Fear: Violence and Discrimination Against LGBT People in El Salvador, Guatemala, and Honduras, and Obstacles to Asylum in the United States (Human Rights Watch)
add.summary: HRW (7 Oct 2020), Guatemala chapter: 'Guatemalan authorities facilitate anti-trans violence is by placing trans women in men's prisons, exposing them to violence, including sexual assault.' Bárbara Herrarte, trans activist with Redmmutrans (Red Multicultural de Mujeres Trans), described her time in a men's prison: 'Always, at night, someone got in my bed and forced me to have sex with him.' Documents birth-sex placement in the men's prison system as of 2020 with sexual-assault risk, and no gender-identity-based placement policy, special trans unit, or trans-specific solitary/segregation practice; LGBTQ org Lambda flags forced internal displacement from violence generally, but no trans-specific custody-policy or court ruling is documented in the report.
